title: ShipmentDeliveryWindowAgreed
description: The Planner agreed a delivery window with the Carrier, outside the TMS, for a Collected or In transit Shipment, from an open Exception (Canonical Model event, version 1). The agreed window replaces the Transport Order's for Late delivery, Stale and the fallback ETA; the Transport Order keeps the Shipper's original window, and earlier agreed windows are kept. Published on the Shipment events topic, under the correlation ID of the agreement, which starts a Message trail of its own because it starts in the TMS UI; the Exception number links it to the Exception. It isn't sent to the Carrier.

occurredAt.description: When the Planner agreed the window.

transportOrderNumber.description: The Transport Order the Shipment carries out; its own window is unchanged.

latest.description: The agreed window's latest time: after now, and not before the earliest.

exceptionNumber.description: The Exception the Planner set the window from.
